title: Reviews
description: What customers think of a product, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button, Card, Progress and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading over the average rating with its stars and the number of reviews, one Progress bar per star rating with its share, a "Write a review" button, then one Card per review with the author's Avatar, name, an optional "Verified purchase" Badge, the stars, the date and the text, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the reviews read a size larger at @sm, the average and the bars sit side by side and the heading steps up at @md, and the summary moves into a column beside the reviews with more room at @lg.
